modules.name: Vinyl Countdown
modules.description: Eight vinyl stages in record order: lathe (hot cut, elliptic, HF limit, groove echo), RIAA cut/play curves, pressing generation and wear, inner-groove tracing, stylus/cartridge, off-centre wow, valve phono preamp (step-up, hum, ground lift) and a drifting second deck. Two assignable CV inputs, bypass, 20 presets. Live audio, max 6 ms latency (plus up to 100 ms on deck B)

modules.name: Scratch
modules.description: Human scratch sequencer: 12 gestures on 8 steps or a trigger, HUMAN timing drift and SLOPPY hands, scratching live audio (rolling or grabbed) or a WAV; live audio passes through between gestures
